verdict.rationale: Oyster's marketing documents multi-country payroll for employees it employs as Employer of Record (EOR), plus contract generation and payments for freelancers, so employees and contractors can both be paid on one platform. Nothing in the evidence addresses US W-2 payroll or 1099 contractor handling, which are the specific worker classifications the story names. missing for 10: evidence of US W-2 employee payroll, 1099 contractor payment and tax-form support, unified pay-run documentation covering both worker types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Instantly generate contracts, send payments, and manage freelance and short-term talent.
